{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Count total number of enrolled patients
total_patients = len(df)

# Count number of patients with SEVERE baseline disease
severe_patients = df[df['severity'] == 'severe'].shape[0]

# Compute the fraction
fraction_severe = severe_patients / total_patients

# Print the result
print(f"Total patients: {total_patients}")
print(f"Severe patients: {severe_patients}")
print(f"Fraction severe: {fraction_severe}")"}
